Fixed orthographic elevated isometric view, 36 degrees, verticals upright, ground ellipses .59 high relative to width. True alpha transparent background. Reference 1 nature.png is the plant/material style. Reference 2 icons_plants.png supplies exact crop identities and colors. Create ONE 4-COLUMN by 4-ROW atlas, sixteen separate SMALL GROWING CROP sprites. Each ROW is one species, columns show its four growth stages. Species by row: 1 carrot (fine feathery tops, orange shoulder), 2 pumpkin (broad lobed leaves, orange pumpkin), 3 strawberry (three-leaf clusters, little white flowers and red berries), 4 sunflower (heart-shaped leaves, tall yellow flower with brown seed center). COLUMN 1: a tiny low oval earth mound with three visible seeds, no plant yet. COLUMN 2: earth mound with a small two-leaf sprout. COLUMN 3: clearly immature leafy plant, no ripe produce; sunflower has a closed green bud, strawberry can have small white flowers. COLUMN 4: mature harvestable plant with its species fruit/flower, healthy natural leaves; carrot's orange shoulder and pumpkin fruit partly rest in the soil. Keep the same soil patch size and center within each row, growing plants above it, no pots. Stages must be unmistakable at small game scale. Seed mounds remain modest and organic, not dark 3D discs. The model supplies no artificial glow.
